# Part 10 · Mobile Systems → AI Systems

**Engineering** · [Watch the reel](https://www.instagram.com/reel/Dc3-zdFxNiV/) · Published 4 Sep 2026

> Which LLM serving problems has a mobile engineer already solved?

If you've shipped a mobile app, you've already handled most of the problems in LLM serving, under other names.

![Whiteboard for Part 10](canvas.png)

## The mapping

- Low-memory killer → preempting a request when the KV cache runs out.
- Virtual memory paging → PagedAttention.
- 16 ms frame budget → time to first token.
- Reactive streams and retry state machines → token streaming and model fallbacks.
- What's actually new: non-deterministic output, embeddings, and cost per call as a design constraint.
